g.text: Dense SVD as matrix dimensions grow

text.style: font-size: 11.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #465866

g.text: 30–120 million entries; geometric low-rank signal plus Gaussian noise

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #465866

g.text: k = 40, p = 10, q = 2 · 5 calls per method · 4 BLAS threads · reference: base::svd

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #465866

g.text: Time: medians, IQR bands, min–max whiskers. Speedup is the ratio of timing medians.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #465866

g.text: Ratios = reference / method; 1× means equal cost. Allocations: one R profile each, not peak RSS.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #465866

g.text: Largest observed residual / optimal rank-40 residual: 1.000667. Setup is excluded.
